terms.workingTarget: R24 relational/institutional/narrative position carrying expectations, rights, duties, permissions, capabilities and/or function
GamePractice-recognized system-boundary role through which participant-side choices/commitments/interpretations are attributed to gameplay/enactment
scope-qualified descriptor for an entity related to a GameStructure, GameInstance, Enactment, PlayPractice or surrounding event through a recognized participation relation
observation-oriented practice/event role with no necessary authoritative GameAction or adjudication channel
one or more observers/participants related through an event/media/practice audience relation; may have aggregate causal channels
role that changes another participant's information/evaluation/policy without necessarily holding direct GameAction authority
role with scoped authority to classify/evaluate events or apply rules to cases and issue binding rulings
role/process that establishes evidence or validity of a history/claim/record under a practice/institution
historically variable role bundle that may combine world presentation, content generation, character control, action interpretation, rule adjudication and social facilitation
practice/platform role with access/governance/enforcement/change authority whose Game-constitutive status is scope- and consequence-dependent
Game/system function that observes player/game state and changes running-game parameters, content, dynamics or transitions toward an objective
case-level process family that can include evidence acquisition, interpretation/classification and authoritative ruling under a rule/evaluation source
overloaded family covering control mapping, semantic interpretation, facilitation, communication, adjudication and experience management; not admitted as one construct
candidate rejected as a new primitive; Game-relative participation is provisionally modeled through existing Role plus scoped relation/channel/authority assignments
candidate derived view over what a role can observe, propose, act on, evaluate, adjudicate, verify, modify, enforce or route at a declared scope
time/currentness/provenance-bound relation between an occupant and a Role at a scope

hiddenAssumptionsRejected: Player is any entity with causal influence on the game
Direct avatar control is necessary for participation
One named role has one atomic function
Game-internal causal component is automatically a participant
Experience manager is an opponent or learning Subject by identity

boundaryCases.pressure: Player role without other human participants; software adjudication exists without human referee
practice/event participation may exist without GameAction or ruling authority
viewer can gain aggregate Game-causal channel without becoming avatar controller
binding decision authority distinct from player and from law/rule authorship
evidence/recommendation role can be separated from final ruling authority
performance producer and authoritative evaluator are different participation roles
one occupant can bundle narration, world generation, NPC control, adjudication and facilitation
policy influence can be causal while direct GameAction authority remains elsewhere
cross-instance record/category validity can depend on external evidence/adjudication authority
platform/practice authority can alter access, sanctions, rules/currentness without being a World Subject
running Game can adapt itself based on player model; causal system function need not be Player
shared control does not imply shared Player identity; GDF1 contribution topology remains separate
Player/participant roles do not require Human phenomenology
same Entity can occupy separable roles with authority conflict
player/Agent can hold gameplay plus rule/content-change role at bounded times
RoleAssignment and causal channels can change while Entity identity persists

externalAnchors.claim: Role is relational/institutional/narrative position; role != occupant; one entity can occupy multiple roles
Player is a role at the system boundary, not necessarily a World Subject
referee has final decision authority while other officials/VAR can supply evidence/recommend review
